title: Adjacent Increasing Subarrays Detection I
summary: Given an array of integers nums and an integer k, check if there are two adjacent subarrays of length k that are strictly increasing.
statement: Given an array of integers nums and an integer k, check if there are two adjacent subarrays of length k that are strictly increasing. Both subarrays must start at indices a and a+k, respectively, and must be strictly increasing.
constraints: Choose two adjacent subarrays, each of length k.
Every neighboring pair inside each chosen subarray must be strictly increasing.
Return whether any valid adjacent pair exists.
hints: Try every possible start of a combined length-2k region.
Check strict increases within its first k positions.
Check the same property independently in the immediately following k positions.
Return true exactly when both checks succeed for one start.
editorial: Return true exactly when both checks succeed for one start.
